heroes.name: Shion
heroes.summary: Drastically tighter aim requirements and increased recovery time significantly lower Shion's dueling consistency and lethality.

heroes.name: Hazard
heroes.summary: Shifting power from survivability and area control into higher individual lethality favors a more aggressive, precision-based playstyle.

changes.note: Heal reduced to 20% of your Max Life (Down from 30%).

heroes.name: Orisa
heroes.summary: Increasing critical impact and heat-scaling weapon power solidifies Orisa as a high-pressure frontline threat for players with accurate tracking.

changes.note: Max Weapon Power based on Heat increased to 40% (Up from 30%).

heroes.name: Zarya
heroes.summary: A substantial raw damage reduction severely impacts Zarya's ability to punish enemies and secure kills even at high energy levels.

heroes.name: Freja
heroes.summary: Reducing the lingering effect duration lowers Freja's passive area denial and total utility uptime.

heroes.name: Genji
heroes.summary: Faster startup and higher base damage provide more immediate burst potential, outweighing the slight reduction in maximum bonus damage.

heroes.name: Mei
heroes.summary: Shortening the freeze window provides enemies more opportunities to escape or react before being fully incapacitated.

heroes.name: Reaper
heroes.summary: Comprehensive nerfs to duration, damage, and crowd control significantly weaken Reaper's effectiveness in close-quarters engagements.

changes.note: Damage reduced to 20% of Max Life (Down from 25%).
Slow and Attack Speed Slow reduced to 20% (Down from 30%).

heroes.name: Torbjörn
heroes.summary: The reduction in fire rate directly lowers Torbjörn's overall DPS and ability to hold down lanes effectively.

heroes.name: Vendetta
heroes.summary: Scaling back both damage amplification and cooldown reduction heavily limits Vendetta's snowball potential during Onslaught.

changes.note: Cooldown Reduction per Onslaught stack reduced to 3% (Down from 5%).

heroes.name: Ana
heroes.summary: Enhancing the percentage-based healing significantly boosts Ana's ability to sustain high-health targets under heavy pressure.

changes.note: Healing per 1s increased to 15% of your Max Life (Up from 10%).

heroes.name: Juno
heroes.summary: Trading significant cooldown utility for a slight increase in fire rate shifts Juno's focus toward direct combat over ability cycling.

changes.note: Shots per second increased to 22 (Up from 20).

heroes.name: Lúcio
heroes.summary: Improving the effectiveness floor enhances Lúcio's utility in situations where his abilities were previously most mitigated.

changes.note: Reduced effectiveness increased to 50% reduced (Up from 60% reduced).

heroes.name: Moira
heroes.summary: Massive buffs to uptime and throughput, combined with stack refreshing, make Moira a dominant force in sustained brawls.

changes.note: Buff duration now resets upon gaining additional stacks.
